parameters.value: AND({Enabled}=TRUE(),{Default Mode}='Approval Required',{OOO Mode}='Approval Required',OR({Workspace Record ID}='recJx0WwHsdsvcVIN',{Workspace Record ID}='recaG8oBGaBKbWlns',{Workspace Record ID}='recZgKU0gdB9AIZ5x',{Workspace Record ID}='recbxOWoWWD8IN8Mn',{Workspace Record ID}='reciYGfy3bI9jsVDo',{Workspace Record ID}='recaSYeQ1KbhUGeAW',{Workspace Record ID}='recynyHPighsOPpjd',{Workspace Record ID}='recBP0AXQ0UYfTYz1'))

parameters.jsCode: const allowed={"recJx0WwHsdsvcVIN": "2", "recaG8oBGaBKbWlns": "68", "recZgKU0gdB9AIZ5x": "78", "recbxOWoWWD8IN8Mn": "72", "reciYGfy3bI9jsVDo": "77", "recaSYeQ1KbhUGeAW": "42", "recynyHPighsOPpjd": "66", "recBP0AXQ0UYfTYz1": "80"};const pages=$input.all().map(x=>x.json);if(pages.some(p=>p.error||!Array.isArray(p.records))||pages.at(-1)?.offset)throw Error('Settings read incomplete');const ids=new Set(),seen=new Set();for(const r of pages.flatMap(p=>p.records)){const f=r.fields||{};if(f.Enabled!==true)continue;const id=String(f['Workspace Record ID']||'');if(!allowed[id])throw Error('Enabled settings missing workspace');if(seen.has(id))throw Error('Duplicate enabled client settings');seen.add(id);let plan;try{plan=JSON.parse(f['Follow-up Plan JSON']||'{}');}catch{throw Error('Invalid enabled follow-up plan');}if(plan.enabled===true&&Array.isArray(plan.steps)&&plan.steps.length)ids.add(id);}if(!ids.size)return [];const clientFilter='OR('+[...ids].map(id=>"{Dulcy Reply Agent Workspace Record ID}='"+id+"'").join(',')+')';return [{json:{filter:"AND("+clientFilter+",{Dulcy Reply Agent State}='Scheduled',{Dulcy Reply Agent Draft}=BLANK(),{DNC}!=TRUE(),{Client Handling}!=TRUE(),{Reply Ownership}!='Handoff',OR({Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action}=BLANK(),{Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action}='None'),{Pipeline Stage}!='Booked Meeting',{Pipeline Stage}!='Completed Meeting',{Pipeline Stage}!='Closed Deal',{Opportunity Status}!='WON',{Opportunity Status}!='LOST',IS_BEFORE({Dulcy Reply Agent Due At},NOW()))"}}];
